name: @ainthek/ast-tools-node
description: Stand-alone tree-sitter AST CLIs (parse / parse-stdin / dump / query / validate) with bundled query set, plus ast-checksum. Extracted from cinderella tools/external/ast-tools.
_aiProvenance: Generated/modified by AI Kilo Code 7.4.22-gratex-016, used model deepseek-v4-flash. (v1.1.0: ported ast-checksum plus its POSIX line-dedupe helper awk-uniq into bin/ from cinderella/tools/external/). (v1.1.2: extracted the PATH bootstrap into the shared bin/_ast_tools.sh; bin/* shell CLIs source it with a one-liner so future tools inherit it without duplicating it.) (v1.1.3: reorganized bin/ into bin/ast/ (ast-tools-* node CLIs + ast-checksum) and bin/lib/ (shared _ast_tools.sh + awk-uniq); the PATH bootstrap now prepends both tool dirs; node tools' ../src and ../queries refs moved to ../../; public .bin commands unchanged.) (v1.1.4: added npm scripts.tests to run the mocha specs under test/ via npx --no-install mocha, with bin/ast prepended to PATH so the spec's execFileSync('ast-tools-query', ...) resolves.) tree-sitter-c-sharp pinned to CJS 0.23.1 (0.23.5 is ESM-only and breaks require()). tree-sitter-plsql is bundled from cinderella (vendored at ./tree-sitter-plsql; native build via node-gyp-build, build/ is git-ignored); consider a published spec before going to registry/github.
